# Paire

> Paire (paire.in) is an Indian dating app for men and women (18+) where women set the rules. Every like can carry a short note, Paire Plus reveals who likes you, and there are no caste filters. It covers everything from casual dating to marriage-minded relationships. Tagline: "Find your Paire."

Paire launched in 2026, open to men and women across India. It runs in any phone or laptop browser at https://www.paire.in/app/ with Google or email sign-in; an Android app is coming.

## Key facts

- Who it's for: adult men and women, 18+. Men see women and women see men by default ("Show me" can be changed).
- Free for everyone: 10 likes a day (each can carry a note), 1 Super Like a day, an anonymous likes preview, mutual matching, reading messages, all privacy and safety controls.
- Sending messages needs your own Paire Plus pass (messaging is included while it runs) or Unlimited Chat: a one-time ₹49 unlock for all current and future mutual matches, with no expiry, no renewal and no per-match charge. Each person needs their own access to send.
- Paire Plus (optional pass, never auto-renews, same price for men and women): ₹399 for 60 days (buy 1 month, get 1 month free, ₹6.65 a day), ₹35 for 1 day, or Lifetime Plus for ₹1,499 once with no expiry while Paire’s Plus service operates on that account. Other durations: ₹99 for 7 days, or a six-month Plus pass at ₹799 for 180 days (about ₹4.44/day), with unlimited regular likes and all other Plus benefits. Every plan reveals who likes you, includes messaging, 5 Super Likes daily, priority likes and the age-gap filter. Monthly, six-month and lifetime plans include unlimited regular likes; day and week passes include 100 regular likes daily. Paid once using the payment methods shown at checkout.
- Women-first controls (free): notes-only likes, "I'll message first", incognito (only people you like can see you), private photos until you match, "same intentions only", "speaks my language".
- Trust signals: confirmed email is required before likes/chat, and known disposable inboxes are blocked. Photo verification is separate and is not currently required for every profile; look for a current photo-check badge. Work-sector badges are self-declared and do not verify employment or qualifications. No badge guarantees identity or intentions.
- Safety: report and block in every chat, Paire AI warnings for money, OTP and scam messages, moderation of reported profiles. Paid arrangements and money requests are banned.
- India-specific: optional basics (height, languages, education, diet, drinking, smoking, religion); religion is never used to filter or rank; no caste field or filter.
- Discovery modes: People (photo cards), Vibe First (interests and intentions before photos), Duos (date together with a best friend), blind date mode.
- Garba Nights: the 11–20 October 2026 Navratri edition has ended. Its public page is an archive; do not describe that season as currently open.
- Paire AI: icebreakers, bio ideas, optional AI vibe matching (opt-in, uses only selected profile choices) and chat-safety checks.

## How Paire compares

- Likes reveal: Paire Plus shows pending liker profiles and notes. Free members see an anonymous count, including likes outside their search filters.
- Versus subscription apps: Paire Plus is a short pass from ₹35 that ends by itself, with no auto-renewal.
- Versus matrimonial sites: Paire covers marriage-minded dating too ("same intentions only"), without caste filters or family-run profiles.
